# iosxe_voice_trunk_group (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Trunk Group configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_trunk_group" "example" {
  name = "PRI-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Trunk group label

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `hunt_scheme_method` (String) hunt scheme method
  - Choices: `least-idle`, `least-used`, `longest-idle`, `random`, `round-robin`, `sequential`
- `max_retry` (Number) Maximum number of outgoing call attempts
  - Range: `1`-`5`
- `translation_profile_incoming` (String) Translation Profile for incoming call leg
- `translation_profile_outgoing` (String) Translation Profile for outgoing call leg

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_trunk_group.example "<name>"
```
